item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues Dollar General for deceptively charging consumers more than advertised for many products
item.description:
Publication Date: November 20, 2026

Joins federal lawsuit with FTC and bipartisan coalition of 30 AGs against Dollar General for routinely charging consumers more at the register than the products advertised and shelf prices
